config-enable-quick-tools-tooltip: Enable the quick-tool radial menu. Assign its hold key in Controls.
quicktool-restore-description: Restore the item held before your first quick-tool selection.
quicktool-rejected: That quick-tool selection is no longer available.
quicktool-interrupted: The swap was interrupted. Your current items were kept; restoration is no longer available.
quicktool-session-unavailable: The previous item can no longer be restored.
quicktool-menu-unavailable: The quick-tool menu could not be opened.
quicktool-binding-unavailable: Bind Quick tools to a keyboard key or the middle or right mouse button.
gui-alloycalculator-dropdown-tooltip: Select the alloy type you want to create
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-tooltip: Transfer required ingredients from your inventory into the crucible
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-inventory-cl: The crucible is no longer open.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-invalid-reci: The requested mixture is not a valid alloy.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-insufficient: You do not have enough ingredients.
There is not enough inventory space to rearrange the crucible.
gui-alloycalculator-deposit-transfer-fai: The deposit failed and all inventory changes were restored.
config-enable-auto-stash-tooltip: Enable auto-stashing items into containers by holding the interact key.
config-enable-ignition-tools-tooltip: Enable lighting fires using lanterns, candles, and oil lamps.
config-enable-spawn-decal-tooltip: Show a glowing decal at the player's respawn point.
config-enable-alloy-calculator-tooltip: Enable the alloy calculator GUI for crucibles.
config-enable-equip-light-hotkey-tooltip: Enable the hotkey to equip light sources to offhand/hotbar.
config-auto-stash-delay-tooltip: Time in seconds to hold the interact key before auto-stashing begins.
config-ignition-delay-tooltip: Time in seconds to hold the interact key before igniting a fire.
config-spawn-decal-size-tooltip: Size of the spawn point decal (0.2 to 1.0).
config-enable-backpack-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting backpacks into leather using knife or shears.
config-enable-linensack-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting linen sacks into flax fibers using knife or shears.
config-enable-metalbits-recycling-toolti: Enable recycling metal tool heads into metal bits using a chisel.
config-enable-stick-recipes-tooltip: Enable crafting sticks from planks and firewood.
config-enable-wattle-decraft-tooltip: Enable decrafting wattle blocks into sticks.
